payload.label: Drives on my computers
payload.job: List the drives connected to this person's computer: each drive's name, where it is mounted, its size and free space, its kind (USB, disk image, internal) and whether it can be ejected
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer while the Trillion app is open there. Returns devices: each with name, mount, size_bytes, free_bytes, kind, internal, ejectable and state.

payload.label: A drive's icon
payload.job: Get the icon Finder shows for one drive connected to this person's computer, as a PNG picture
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. Returns mount, media_type and base64 (the PNG).

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:trillion-media-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

payload.label: What is on a drive
payload.job: Tell what is on one drive connected to this person's computer by kind of file (videos, pictures, sound, documents), with how many of each and how much space they take
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer; the first read of a drive runs in the background, and a kept read is used for 6 hours.

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:trillion-media-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

payload.label: Look inside a folder on a drive
payload.job: List the files and folders in one folder on a drive connected to this person's computer, a page at a time
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. hidden "1" includes hidden files; offset and limit page through a long folder.

path.description: A full path on a connected drive, like /Volumes/Drive/DCIM

payload.label: What is using a drive
payload.job: Name the programs on this person's computer that are using one drive right now, which would stop it from ejecting
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. Returns mount and processes (each pid and name).

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:trillion-media-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

payload.label: Where else a file is
payload.job: Find every other place one file on this person's computer also is (a duplicate): on their other connected drives and in their Trillion space
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. path is the file on a connected drive.

path.description: A full path on a connected drive, like /Volumes/Drive/DCIM

payload.label: Drive work in progress
payload.job: List the long file jobs running on this person's computer drives (copies and moves): how far each has got, and whether it can be paused, resumed or stopped now
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. Returns work: each job with its id, what it is doing and the controls it takes now.

payload.label: Pause, resume or stop drive work
payload.job: Pause, resume or stop one long file job on this person's computer drives (a copy or a move), optionally resuming it at a chosen time
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. id is the job from tool:trillion-media-work; action is one of the controls it lists; check true only says whether that control is ready.

action.description: A control tool:trillion-media-work lists for this job, like pause, resume or stop

resume_at.description: When to resume, as an ISO time

check.description: true only looks: says what would happen and changes nothing

payload.label: Copy or move files between drives
payload.job: Copy or move files and folders to one or more folders on drives connected to this person's computer, as a long job that can be paused and stopped
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. sources are full paths; destinations are folders on connected drives; mode is copy or move. check true previews what would be copied and changes nothing.

check.description: true only looks: says what would happen and changes nothing

payload.label: Eject a drive
payload.job: Eject one drive connected to this person's computer safely, so it can be unplugged
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. check true only names anything still using the drive and ejects nothing.

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:trillion-media-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

check.description: true only looks: says what would happen and changes nothing
